description.en: Paper-reading workspace inside DeepSeek Harness: imports local PDFs, arXiv IDs or links, shows a page-by-page bilingual view (translated page next to the original, layout preserved), translates whatever you drag over next to the cursor, and answers questions about the paper with clickable [p.12] page citations. Notes, diagrams, cloud sync and per-paper token usage included; everything stays on your machine.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的论文阅读工作台：支持本地 PDF、arXiv 编号或链接导入；中英整页对照（左中文页、右原版页，版式保留）；拖选任意文字即在光标旁出译文；提问会得到带 [p.12] 页码引用的回答，点一下跳回原文。另有笔记、框架图、云同步与按论文统计的 token 消耗，数据全部留在本机。
